diagnosis.what_happened: Headings lacked preceding blank lines and had trailing blank lines. Appendices included non-table narrative and scoring text.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Defective DOCX generation and failure to filter out irrelevant text during Appendices compilation.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Strictly inject one blank line before headings, zero trailing blank lines after headings. Filter out all non-table text from Appendices.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Adherence to OpenXML/Markdown heading standards and strict Appendix constraints requiring only tables.

desired_behavior: Enforce explicit blank line logic for headings. Implement a strict filter for Appendices to strip narrative/scoring text, retaining only the table and its title.
generalization: Formatting boundaries must be explicitly enforced in generators, and section-specific content filters must be applied to exclude non-compliant text.

evidence.observed_value: Formatting errors and text leak in Appendices
